Seventeen retained quests changed preserved reward definitions from items to XP.
Required clean-client, completion, reward, team, synchronization and copied-world tests were not run.
The established 1.8.1-packwiz.1 version lineage was replaced by the lower 1.1.0-rc1 identifier.
A generated config containing a password value and a generated patron cache containing third-party UUID/name data are tracked and Packwiz-managed.
.gitignore does not ignore a standalone playerdata directory.
Four mojibake em-dash sequences remain in three Create descriptions.
